question: "Kalidas Samman" is a prestigious arts award presented annually by the government of (RPF Constable(Ancillary) 2018 (31/03/2019) Shift 2)
options: Arunachal Pradesh
Himachal Pradesh
Madhya Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Madhya Pradesh

Explanation:
The Kalidas Samman is a prestigious arts award presented annually by the government of Madhya Pradesh. It was instituted in 1980. The award is given for excellence in the fields of music, dance, theatre, and visual arts. It is named after the famous Sanskrit poet Kalidasa. The recipient receives a cash prize of 2 lakh rupees, a citation, and a plaque. This award plays a significant role in promoting Indian culture and arts.

question: In 1968, late Indian composer Pandit Ravi Shankar became the very first Indian to win the Grammy Award for which of the following music albums in the ‘Best Chamber Music Performance’ category? (RPF Constable 2024 (17/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: The Living Room Sessions
Full Circle: Carnegie Hall 2000
West Meets East
The Concert for Bangladesh
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is West Meets East

Explanation:
In 1968, Pandit Ravi Shankar won the Grammy Award for Best Chamber Music Performance for the album West Meets East. This collaborative album featured Ravi Shankar on sitar and Yehudi Menuhin on violin. It was the first time an Indian musician won a Grammy. The album blended Western classical music with Indian classical music, making a significant impact on the global music scene. Ravi Shankar is credited with popularizing Indian classical music worldwide. He later won a total of five Grammy Awards, including a Lifetime Achievement Award.

question: Harold C Urey was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, in 1934: (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (12/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: for discovery in the chemistry of the transuranium elements
for the discovery of heavy hydrogen
for the discovery and development of conductive polymers
for the development of the density-functional theory
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is for the discovery of heavy hydrogen

Explanation:
Harold C Urey was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1934 for the discovery of heavy hydrogen, also known as deuterium. Deuterium has a nucleus containing one proton and one neutron. Urey discovered deuterium in 1931. This discovery was significant for atomic physics and chemistry. Deuterium is used as a moderator in nuclear reactors and as a tracer in biochemical studies. Urey later conducted research on the development of the Moon and planets.

question: Which biochemist was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1958 for his work on the structure of proteins, especially insulin?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (09/09/2025) Shift 1)
options: Frederick Sanger
Rosalind Franklin
Eduard Buchner
Carl Neuberg
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Frederick Sanger

Explanation:
Frederick Sanger was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1958 for his work on the structure of proteins, especially insulin. He was the first scientist to determine the complete amino acid sequence of a protein. Insulin is a polypeptide hormone that regulates blood sugar levels. Rosalind Franklin is known for her work on DNA structure, while Buchner and Neuberg are associated with fermentation chemistry.

question: As of 2020, the only person who has received the Nobel prize for physics twice is: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Marie Curie
John Bardeen
Arthur Ashkin
Lawrence Bragg
solution:

Explanation:

Solution: सही उत्तर है बचपन बचाओ आंदोलन

Explanation:
कैलाश सत्यार्थी एक प्रसिद्ध बाल अधिकार कार्यकर्ता और 2014 के नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार के सह-विजेता हैं। उन्होंने बचपन बचाओ आंदोलन (BBA) की स्थापना 1980 में की थी। यह संगठन बाल श्रम, बाल तस्करी और बाल शोषण के खिलाफ काम करता है। उनके नेतृत्व में, बचपन बचाओ आंदोलन ने भारत और दुनिया भर में लाखों बच्चों को बचाया है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं: बेटी बचाओ बेटी पढ़ाओ एक सरकारी पहल है; SOS गाँव अनाथ बच्चों की देखभाल करता है; Child Relief and You एक बाल कल्याण संस्था है जिससे वे जुड़े नहीं हैं।
